monitoring of traction force during vacuum extraction
Monitoring of traction force during vacuum extraction
outcome: Failed extraction (emergency Cesarean or forceps delivery)
Complicated delivery (duration >15 min, pulls >6, cup detachment >1)
cohort: Women who underwent mid or low vacuum extraction deliveries (n=1074)
finding: Implementation of clinical team training and monitoring of traction force during vacuum extraction led to a significant decrease in failed and complicated deliveries, but did not impact neonatal outcomes.
